note: Solano County park on Lake Solano, the Putah Creek afterbay below Monticello Dam, west of Winters. Several premium sites sit along the shore; the day-use area with a hand launch for canoes and kayaks lies across Pleasants Valley Road. The entrance gate is locked at 9 pm. --Claude
summary: Lake Solano County Park: open, under construction (some lower roads and water access interrupted). The count is corrected from 90 to 58 (36 water/electric at 30 A, 2 full hookups, so sewer flips false -> true). Fees $30-65 (2024 schedule; a 2027 change is announced but unread). Reservable on the county Camava engine, max 14 nights, with first-come-only periods during construction. Lakefront (AWH ruling on lake width) confirmed at sites 25 and 26. Website and phone fixed. Note rewritten.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront kept; the AWH size ruling is in the evidence. Site 26 (Non-Utility Premium, engine point 38.494691,-122.032203) is ~20 m from the water across open grass, and its engine photo shows the lake just past the table. Site 25 (Utility Premium, 38.494471,-122.031570) is ~15 m from the bank through scattered leafless trees on the winter Esri frame. Both are sold by the night. Sites 28 and 31 sit behind a thicker riparian belt.
SITES: count 90 -> 58 (the engine and park description: '58 campsites ... 36 have water and electric hookups').
HOOKUPS: sewer false -> true (2 full-hookup sites, 14 and 29); electric 30 A added.
PHONE: empty -> 530-795-2990 (park office; same on the engine and the status page).

STATUS: road and facility construction 'through September 2026 at least'. The campground was on first-come-first-served only while it ran, but the engine is again taking reservations from 12/10/2026, and the status page still lists interrupted access to some lower roads and to the water access.
PIN: stored 38.49330,-122.03080 is at the east end of the camp beside sites 2 and 56, ~230 m from the middle of the loops. Under 250 m; left as is.
UNREAD: the 2027 Lake Solano fee changes the county Park Fees page announces. No link was present on the page, so the 2024 schedule is used.
